# <span id="aanchor155"></span> Email

You can send emails from within the FLOWCAL application.

Make sure you have configured the settings in the Email section of the Report Scheduler Configuration (**Reports** \> **Report Scheduler** \> **Configuration**).

<div class="procedure">

To send an email from FLOWCAL:

1.  Go to **Tools** \> **Email**.
2.  Click the **To** button to select a recipient.
3.  Enter a subject.
4.  Click the **Attachment** button to attach a file, if necessary.
5.  Enter your message, and click the **Send** button.
